description: This file implements the AWCProxyContainer class and its nested DBusInterface class, which manage container state changes and control container lifecycle (start/stop) via D-Bus communication in a process container management system.

classes.name: AWCProxyContainer::DBusInterface
classes.description: Handles D-Bus communication for container state changes, including onStateChange notifications.

classes.name: AWCProxyContainer
classes.description: Manages container lifecycle, including starting and stopping containers, and monitors their state via D-Bus.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::DBusInterface::onStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when the container's state changes, updating internal state and notifying waiting threads.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits for the container's application state to change to a specified state within a timeout period.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::AWCProxyContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the container with configuration and establishing D-Bus interface binding.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::~AWCProxyContainer
methods.description: Destructor unbinding D-Bus interface and stopping the container if it is running.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently in the STARTED state.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters, waiting for it to reach the STARTED state.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting for it to reach the STOPPED state.
